summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to discuss phases 56 and 57 of the CipherBox milestone, open a docs PR for the newly-added phases 56–58, and kick off background planning for phase 56 in an isolated worktree.
summary.outcome: Phase 56 (FUSE/IPNS Durability Hardening) and phase 57 (API CID/Provider Hardening) were both discussed and CONTEXT.md files created; docs PR #539 was opened and merged; background plan-phase 56 agent was spawned in a dedicated worktree; phase 57 context was committed on its own branch off updated main.

repo: The system uses CIDv1 (cid-version=1 on Kubo add); UnpinDto.CID_REGEX already covers both v0+v1 (/^(Qm…{44}|b[a-z2-7]{58,})$/), so phase 57's fix is extract-and-tighten, not a new design decision.
winfsp builds are CI-only on macOS — local cargo never compiles windows/* crates; the Windows CI gate is the authoritative correctness signal and macOS/Windows paths must change in lockstep.

Conflict-retry handling is inconsistent across Rust publish sites: metadata.rs:136–214 (folder publish) already does correct re-resolve+retry; content_ops.rs:167 (per-file) and metadata.rs:340 (bin) silently swallow Conflict as success — the bug.
mkdir uses a separate MkdirConflict event-channel re-arm that is platform-duplicated and intentionally out of scope for phase 56.
Zeroization rule: a callee must NOT zero a caller-owned/reused buffer; only the terminal owner zeroes — the createAndPublishIpnsRecord regression broke 48/89 SDK E2E by violating this.
Phases 56–58 are deferred-findings phases sourced from PR #538 review; they were only added to the roadmap in commit d24c111f4 and were not yet on main at session start.
GSD commit helper auto-switches to the feat/* branch when it commits phase docs, requiring manual branch reorganization before opening a docs-only PR.

code.finding: Folder IPNS publish already implements the correct re-resolve+retry loop on Conflict — the pattern to extract into a shared helper.
Per-file IPNS publish swallows Conflict as success — bug to fix by reusing the shared CAS-retry helper.
Bin IPNS publish also swallows Conflict as success — same bug, same fix.

workflow: Background agents in the GSD harness CAN nest subagents (plan-checker, worktree executors) — the earlier manager.md caveat about backgrounding being unsafe on Claude Code is outdated.

For docs that must land on main before a feature branch is created: branch off the specific roadmap commit for the discuss step, open a docs-only PR, then reset the feature branch to updated main after merge — avoids polluting the docs PR with phase context commits.
Phase discuss can legitimately skip interactive gray-area questions when the ROADMAP + folded todos already lock all decisions — writing CONTEXT directly is valid and faster.
1Password SSH commit signing can fail with 'failed to write commit object' and requires a biometric approval retry; --no-verify must not be used as a workaround.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed on the first commit attempt ('failed to write commit object'), requiring a full retry and ~80s poll wait for biometric approval.
Unrelated Cargo.lock drift (cipherbox-fuse 0.6.1→0.7.0, cipherbox-sdk 0.6.0→0.7.0) appeared as a modified file and had to be carefully excluded from the docs PR.

GSD commit helper silently switched branches to feat/fuse-and-ipns-durability-hardening after committing phase 56 docs, requiring manual fast-forward and push of docs/planning-20260621 before the PR could be opened.
Phase 57 branch required careful isolation (branched off roadmap commit d24c111f4, not off the phase-56-context commits) to avoid including 56-CONTEXT.md in PR #539.
